whoFor: Foreign companies, investors and diaspora founders setting up a company in Nigeria, managed from wherever they are.

benefits.title: A clear sequence
benefits.text: Each registration and permit in the order it is needed.

benefits.title: Remote by design
benefits.text: Documents, signing and updates handled without you travelling.

benefits.title: One coordinator in Nigeria
benefits.text: A named person who tracks every step on West Africa Time (UTC+1).

whatYouReceive: A set-up plan listing each registration, permit and document
Coordination of the other registrations your plan needs, such as tax and investment registrations
A records pack and a calendar of the filings that follow
whatYouProvide: Details of the foreign shareholders and directors, with identification
Your intended activities and share structure
Documents notarised or certified where the rules require it
Your written authority for SCS to act on your behalf
doesNotInclude: A promise of when any agency will process an application, or of its decision
Immigration status for individuals, which is scoped separately
